summary: Morpheus leads Neo into a cramped high-tech room where Apoc, Switch, Cypher and Trinity are hardwiring monitors and drives to get on-line. Neo is seated and Trinity fixes electrode disks to him, with headphones wired to an old hotel phone. Morpheus explains the pill was a trace program to pinpoint his location; Cypher quips that Kansas is going bye-bye. As the crew works, Neo notices a cracked mirror healing into liquid, and his fingers sink into it, stretching like taffy. While Morpheus questions whether he could tell a dream from reality, the mirror gel crawls up his arms, neck and nose, throwing him into fibrillation and arrest. The crew races to lock his target and Tank sends the signal; a high-pitched electric scream erupts in the headphones, Neo arches in agony, and everything is sucked into his scream and swallowed by darkness.

what_changes.before: He accepts the physical setup but does not understand the mechanics, asking Morpheus "What does that mean?" after being told the pill is a trace program.
what_changes.after: He is overwhelmed by a reality that violates his expectations, murmuring "This can't be..." as the mirror liquefies and consumes him.
what_changes.evidence:
NEO
What does that mean?
CYPHER
It means buckle up, Dorothy,
'cause Kansas is going bye-bye.

what_changes.before: He is merely anxious and curious, whispering to Trinity "You did all this?" while electrodes are gently fixed to him.
what_changes.after: He is in physical crisis, panicking as the mirror invades his body: "It's cold," then screaming as his eyes tear with mirror and his body arches in agony.
what_changes.evidence:
The mirror creeps up his neck as Neo begins to panic,
tipping his head as though he were sinking into the
mirror, trying to keep his mouth up.

what_changes.before:
He sits voluntarily and is handled gently, "in the center of the room and Trinity
begins gently fixing white electrode disks to him."
what_changes.after: His body goes into medical emergency, with Trinity reporting "I got fibrillation!" and "He's going into arrest!" as mercury runs from his nose.
what_changes.evidence:
TRINITY
I got fibrillation!
MORPHEUS
Shit!  Apoc?
Streams of mercury run from Neo's nose.

what_changes.before: She is the technician attaching the electrodes and, when Neo whispers, quietly confirms her authorship of the setup.
what_changes.after: She becomes the medical monitor driving the emergency response, reading his vital signs and declaring the crisis: "It's going into replication" and "I got fibrillation!"
what_changes.evidence:
TRINITY
It's going into replication.
MORPHEUS
Apoc?

what_changes.before: They are methodically preparing, with Apoc reporting they are "Almost" on-line while hardwiring the system.
what_changes.after: They are in a pressured countdown, with Morpheus demanding "Now, Tank, now!" as Apoc locks the target and the signal is sent.
what_changes.evidence:
APOC
Lock!  I got him!
MORPHEUS
Now, Tank, now!

event_hint.one_line: The crew runs a trace-and-extraction procedure on Neo, which spirals into a medical emergency as the mirror-liquid consumes him before the signal is sent.

uncertain: Whether Switch speaks or only looks up, since the scene only says the group "look up as they enter."
Whether Neo actually loses consciousness at the end or is simply pulled into darkness by the scream.

minds.wants: To keep his footing in a situation that has stopped obeying the rules he trusts.
minds.feels: A mounting, wordless terror as his own body becomes evidence against everything he assumed about reality; the whisper 'You did all this?' is less curiosity than a man reaching for a witness who might confirm the world still makes sense.
minds.shows: He stays seated, lets Trinity fix the electrodes, and asks small questions ('What does that mean?', 'Did you...?'), trying to sound merely puzzled rather than frightened — until 'It's cold' and then the scream tear everything open.
minds.basis: He whispers to Trinity, asks Morpheus 'What does that mean?', stares wide-eyed at the mirror, then panics physically as the gel climbs his body.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is a guide who will explain and protect him through what comes next.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus is deliberately letting the horror happen and philosophizing through it; Neo does not yet know he is a candidate being unplugged, not a guest being briefed.

believes_about.belief: That she is the safe, gentle one — the author of the setup he can trust.
believes_about.wrong_because: Not wrong yet in feeling, but he cannot know her gentleness is the competence of someone who has done this extraction before and is about to watch him go into arrest.

minds.wants: To carry Neo across the threshold of disbelief using questions rather than reassurance, and to get the extraction done before the trace fails.
minds.feels: Controlled urgency — he is watching a body go into crisis while choosing to keep asking 'How would you know the difference?' because the unmaking of Neo's certainty is the point, not a side effect.
minds.shows: Calm, almost meditative Socratic speech about dreams, while simultaneously barking orders to Tank and Apoc; the philosophy and the command are the same steady voice.
minds.basis: He explains the trace, lectures Neo on dream vs. reality as the mirror consumes him, and drives the countdown ('Now, Tank, now!').

believes_about.belief: That Neo is 'the one' worth this risk — that the man panicking in the chair can survive what is being done to him.
believes_about.wrong_because: Unproven at this moment; the scene ends in arrest, and whether Neo lives through the unplugging is exactly what the coming scenes must answer.

minds.wants: To keep Neo alive and get his signal locked before his body fails completely.
minds.feels: The shift from gentle technician to emergency responder — her whispered nod to 'You did all this?' becomes a flat clinical reading of fibrillation; she does not have room to feel for him while his vitals collapse.
minds.shows: She stays terse and factual ('It's going into replication,' 'I got fibrillation,' 'He's going into arrest!'), converting alarm into information the crew can act on.
minds.basis: She fixes electrodes gently, then becomes the monitor declaring each stage of the crisis.

believes_about.belief: That this particular man can be pulled through — that her work and Morpheus's gamble will land him safely.
believes_about.wrong_because: The scene gives no guarantee; her confidence is discipline, not foreknowledge, and the scream-and-darkness ending leaves his survival genuinely unresolved.

minds.wants: To get the system on-line and lock Neo's target before the trace window closes.
minds.feels: A crew's collective pressure that tips from methodical setup into a hard countdown the instant the body goes into arrest — no time for the awe Neo is feeling, only for the next command.
minds.shows: Apoc's clipped status calls ('Almost,' 'Still nothing,' 'Targeting... almost there,' 'Lock! I got him!'); Cypher's 'buckle up, Dorothy' is the only release of tension, and it lands as gallows humor rather than comfort.
minds.basis: They report progress while hardwiring, then fire the targeting and signal sequence under Morpheus's 'Now, Tank, now!'

believes_about.belief: That he is another mind to be unplugged — a job, not a marvel — and that the procedure will work as it has before.
believes_about.wrong_because: They cannot know Neo is unlike every prior candidate; the replication crisis and the scream suggest this unplugging is not routine, which the coming events will confirm.

connects_back: sc-029: Morpheus's 'Alice down the rabbit hole' and 'the look of a man who accepts what he sees because he is expecting to wake up' — this scene literalizes that by making the dream/reality boundary physically dissolve.
sc-028: Trinity's advice 'Be honest. He knows more than you can possibly imagine' pays off as Morpheus's questioning, not comforting, method.
sc-027→sc-029: The journey to meet the legend ends in the mundane horror of an old hotel room wired with stolen gear — the 'putrefying elegance' continuing into the cracked mirror.
sets_up: ev-006: The extraction that begins here completes as Neo's physical body wakes in the pod, so his arrest and scream are the last moment of the Matrix-self dissolving.
ev-007: The 'sucked into darkness' end is the transit into the waste-disposal flush that carries him out of the facility.
ev-008: His near-fatal unplugging makes necessary the atrophied-body reconstruction on the Nebuchadnezzar.
ev-010: Morpheus breaking 'the rule against freeing older minds' is the retrospective judgment on the gamble this scene shows him taking.
dramatic_function: To convert Neo's intellectual curiosity into visceral, bodily disbelief — the philosophy Morpheus preaches becomes a physical assault — so that the audience, not just Neo, loses the ability to trust the reality on screen, and the unplugging reads as both a rescue and a violation.
